pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Northpoint CPA is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A calm, glass-walled boardroom at dusk over a city skyline

children: Northpoint CPA is a modern advisory and wealth practice for established businesses and the people who run them. We pair the rigor of a traditional CPA firm with the forward view of a CFO and the discipline of a private wealth office.
We took the parts of accounting that clients value — the strategy, the counsel, the person who knows their whole picture — and made them the whole relationship, not the afterthought at year-end.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every engagement opens with a real conversation about the business, the numbers and where you want to be in three years.
Your advisor holds the full view — tax, cash flow, valuation and personal wealth — so the advice is joined-up, never siloed.
We revisit the plan on a standing quarterly cadence, so strategy keeps pace with the business instead of drifting out of date.
